name: Indian Butter Chicken
notes: Tess discovered this recipe and after several rave reviews, we made it for the groom’s dinner the night before Luke and Lara’s wedding in 2016! Yum.

steps.title: Caramelize the onion
steps.body: Sauté **1 onion, minced** in **a few Tbsp butter** to caramelize, about 15 min.

steps.title: Bake the chicken
steps.body: Meanwhile, toss **1½ lb chicken** with **2 Tbsp oil** and **2 Tbsp Tandoori Masala**, then bake at 375°F until cooked through.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Melt remaining butter along with **1 Tbsp minced garlic**, **1 × 15 oz can tomato sauce**, **3 cups heavy cream**, **2 tsp salt**, **1 tsp cayenne**, and **1 tsp garam masala**. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve with basmati rice; add sautéed onions, coconut, sliced almonds, and raisins.
